patterns_noted: Refined rule set: (1) A same-day beat-and-raise that is already +9.6% is a pullback-buy via trigger, NEVER a market-order chase — the durable post-earnings drift is best captured after the first-day gap consolidates. (2) A stock DOWN on its own EPS beat (KMX -5.9%) because of a management-guided margin warning is the market pricing the durable signal over the headline — this is my AAL disqualification rule and it held. (3) Analyst RE-iterations with MAINTAINED price targets are the weakest analyst action and are not a tradable catalyst (COIN flat-on-three-notes = distribution). (4) Index-inclusion edge lives in the MOC imbalance on the day BEFORE the effective open; the tell that it's still available is a flat stock with no outsized prior pop. Verify by exit_thesis next cycle whether WSBC delivered the MOC bid.
